name: 工具调用判定
description: An optional decision model (any saved local or API profile) reviews risky tool calls before they run: one batched request per step, advise-only by default, optional repair and reject-once, fail-open, with counters that show whether it helps.

features.name: 零模型成本前置检查（参数、路径、编辑匹配、过期读取、Shell 语法、命令可用性与重复失败）
features.nameEn: Model-free preflight checks (schema, paths, edit match, stale reads, shell dialect, PATH, repeated failures)

features.name: 执行前判定高风险工具调用（每步一次批量请求，失败放行）
features.nameEn: Pre-execution verdicts on risky tool calls (one batched request per step, fail-open)

features.name: 可选：修正参数后再执行
features.nameEn: Optional: run the call with repaired arguments

features.name: 可选：拦下调用一次，原样重试时放行
features.nameEn: Optional: stop a call once; an unchanged retry runs

features.name: 判定统计：耗时、修正成功与误拦
features.nameEn: Verdict statistics: judge time, successful repairs and wrong blocks

features.name: 选择判定模型（本地或 API）与判定方式
features.nameEn: Judge model choice (local or API) and verdict settings
